Inspection, Testing & Documentation

Testing & Quality Assurance

Every overhaul and rewind includes inspection, measurement, testing and documentation, so the repair is supported by records.

Submit an RFQ

A boiler circulation pump cannot be assessed on appearance alone. Its condition has to be measured, and the repair verified before it returns to service. DEI VOX describes quality as part of the whole job, from incoming inspection and teardown measurements through repair, testing and documentation.

Service Detail

Certified Management Systems

The source document lists management-system certifications to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018. View the certificate details and downloadable documents on the certificates page.

View Certificates (PDF)

Service Detail

Our Quality Process, Step by Step

  1. 01

    Incoming inspection

    The unit is received, logged, photographed and checked against its nameplate and paperwork; transit damage is recorded.

  2. 02

    Pre-work checks

    Initial electrical and mechanical readings are recorded before teardown.

  3. 03

    Teardown & measurement

    Components are tagged and measured against design values; wear, damage and likely causes are documented.

  4. 04

    Scope approval

    Findings and recommendations are sent for approval before repair begins.

  5. 05

    Controlled repair

    Work follows documented procedures and materials are matched to the job.

  6. 06

    In-process checks

    Critical dimensions, fits and clearances are verified at key stages.

  7. 07

    Final testing & release

    Applicable tests are recorded and the job record reviewed before release for packing.

  8. 08

    Packing & dispatch

    Export-ready packing is accompanied by a documentation pack.

Service Detail

Testing We Perform

Pump overhaul

  • Dimensional inspection of critical parts against design values
  • Clearance and fit verification at assembly
  • Dynamic balancing of the rotating assembly
  • Non-destructive examination of repaired or critical components, as applicable
  • Hydrostatic pressure test
  • Vibration or run test

Motor repair & rewinding

  • Insulation-resistance and polarisation checks
  • Winding-resistance measurement
  • High-voltage and surge testing
  • Hydrostatic test of the motor pressure boundary
  • Rotor balancing and vibration checks
  • No-load test

Service Detail

Customer Inspection Options

  • Customer or inspector witness at agreed hold points, in person
  • Remote witness by live video
  • Third-party inspection by an agency nominated by the customer
  • Hold points and an inspection plan agreed before work starts

Witness arrangements and the inspection plan are agreed for each project.

Service Detail

Confidentiality & Data Protection

Drawings, reports and test data are treated as confidential. DEI VOX will sign an NDA on request and use technical information to deliver the relevant job.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which standards do you work to?

The stated management-system certifications are ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018. Technical acceptance follows the design values, customer specifications or applicable standard agreed for the job.

Can my customer witness the tests?

In-person, remote or third-party witnessing can be arranged, with hold points agreed in advance.

What does the test report include?

The tests carried out, measured values, dates and relevant personnel or approvals.

Are test instruments calibrated?

The source document states instruments are calibrated at defined intervals and records are kept.

Do you issue certificates of conformity for parts?

The source document states certificates of conformity can be issued; requirements should be confirmed for the specific part and scope.

How long are job records retained?

The source document states a 10-year retention period.

What happens if a test result is outside tolerance?

Work stops, the customer is informed, and options and the next step are agreed before continuing.

What warranty applies to repaired units?

The source document states the standard OEM warranty. Confirm applicable terms in the project quotation.
